rivals.reason: The Camaro SS offers similar muscle car performance and a distinct exhaust note that car enthusiasts admire.
With its iconic styling and powerful HEMI V8, the Challenger R/T delivers a legendary cold-start sound comparable to the Mustang GT.
The 370Z Nismo combines sporty handling and a throaty exhaust note, appealing to those who enjoy performance coupes like the Mustang.
The BRZ's boxer engine provides a unique sound, making it an intriguing contrast in a cold-start comparison with the American muscle of the Mustang.
